_comment: Tutorial step 'accumulators' as a Frank cinematic.

steps.name: Frank
steps.text: Quick tip before your first match: route power through an Accumulator and it banks a BIG shot on keys 1, 2, or 3 - your regular trigger keeps working, at half strength while the bank fills, full once it's ready.

steps.name: Frank
steps.text: Or skip the bank key: park one right NEXT TO a Weapon Mount or Missile Rack instead and it stretches how big a burst that mount can charge on its own before firing - even a basic Common one helps now, better rarities stretch it further.

steps.name: Frank
steps.text: Press the key, watch the fireworks. The kids call it the nuke button. I also call it the nuke button.
